modules.objective: Consolidate RLS policies into a single robust admin check and unify public read visibility.
Add composite UNIQUE constraints to prevent duplicate favorites/standings and index critical FKs.
Move match events from JSONB to a relational match_events table for advanced stats.
Optimize standings and match list queries with composite indices covering common filters.
Support the new UI Labeling feature for standings (Promotions, Relegations, etc).

verification_steps: Run npx supabase db push or execute concatenated SQL in Dashboard.
Verify no 'Could not find table' errors in the UI.
Verify admin functions can still manage all entities.
Verify anonymous users can still see public matches/standings.
